summary: Blocks any write or shell command that deletes a Vercel project, through the CLI or a REST DELETE.
doc: This hook denies a Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit or Bash call that deletes a Vercel project: the rm subcommand of the Vercel CLI's project command, or a REST DELETE against /vN/projects/ followed by the project id alone. An automated cleanup that deletes projects reports success and errors on nothing, and a project created today has no custom domain yet, so no age, traffic or name rule makes automated deletion safe. Deleting a project is a decision a person makes by hand. A DELETE against a subresource (env, domains, alias, link) and a GET of the project are allowed. To mention the command on purpose, put it on a comment line (# or //): comment lines are not scanned.
